title: benchmark-proteinfamilies pipeline parameters
description: Benchmark protein family reconstruction tools against manually curated InterPro families.

input_options.title: Input options
input_options.description: Pipeline mode and legacy input alias.

input.description: Legacy input parameter reserved for compatibility; mode-specific inputs are configured with PRE or POST parameters.

workflow_mode.description: Select the workflow branch to run. Use 'pre' to sample curated InterPro families and create the benchmark universe; use 'post' to compare tool outputs against a PRE universe.

pre_options.title: PRE workflow options
pre_options.description: Parameters used when workflow_mode is 'pre' and ignored by POST runs. Each reference database takes a *_db path, a *_latest_link URL used when that path is null, and a *_version string kept for provenance only.

interpro_hierarchy_db.description: Path to the InterPro ParentChildTreeFile.txt hierarchy.
interpro_hierarchy_db.help_text: Leave null to download it from the matching *_latest_link. Downloaded databases are published under <outdir>/pre/databases; point this parameter at that directory to reuse them on a later run instead of refetching.

interpro_hierarchy_latest_link.description: URL of the InterPro ParentChildTreeFile.txt fetched when interpro_hierarchy_db is null.

interpro_mapping_db.description: Path to the InterPro XML mapping file read by EXTRACT_CANDIDATE_INTERPRO_FAMILIES, typically interpro.xml.gz.
interpro_mapping_db.help_text: Leave null to download it from the matching *_latest_link. Downloaded databases are published under <outdir>/pre/databases; point this parameter at that directory to reuse them on a later run instead of refetching.

interpro_mapping_latest_link.description: URL of the InterPro XML mapping file fetched when interpro_mapping_db is null.

interpro_release.description: InterPro release recorded for provenance in the process tag and execution report. Downloads follow the interpro_*_latest_link parameters, not this value.

skip_hamap.description: Skip the HAMAP member database entirely.
skip_hamap.help_text: Families belonging to this database are excluded from the benchmark universe. At least one of the four member databases must remain enabled. Nextflow passes `--skip_x true` from the CLI as a string, so a string-encoded boolean is accepted here; the workflow coerces it. The bare flag form `--skip_x` also works.

hamap_db.description: Path to the HAMAP alignment directory.
hamap_db.help_text: Leave null to download it from the matching *_latest_link. Downloaded databases are published under <outdir>/pre/databases; point this parameter at that directory to reuse them on a later run instead of refetching.

hamap_latest_link.description: URL of the HAMAP archive fetched when hamap_db is null.

hamap_version.description: HAMAP release recorded for provenance in the process tag and execution report. Downloads follow hamap_latest_link, not this value.

skip_ncbifam.description: Skip the NCBIfam member database entirely.
skip_ncbifam.help_text: Families belonging to this database are excluded from the benchmark universe. At least one of the four member databases must remain enabled. Nextflow passes `--skip_x true` from the CLI as a string, so a string-encoded boolean is accepted here; the workflow coerces it. The bare flag form `--skip_x` also works.

ncbifam_db.description: Path to the NCBIfam SEED alignment directory.
ncbifam_db.help_text: Leave null to download it from the matching *_latest_link. Downloaded databases are published under <outdir>/pre/databases; point this parameter at that directory to reuse them on a later run instead of refetching.

ncbifam_latest_link.description: URL of the NCBIfam archive fetched when ncbifam_db is null.

ncbifam_version.description: NCBIfam release recorded for provenance in the process tag and execution report. Downloads follow ncbifam_latest_link, not this value.

skip_panther.description: Skip the PANTHER member database entirely.
skip_panther.help_text: Families belonging to this database are excluded from the benchmark universe. At least one of the four member databases must remain enabled. Nextflow passes `--skip_x true` from the CLI as a string, so a string-encoded boolean is accepted here; the workflow coerces it. The bare flag form `--skip_x` also works.

panther_db.description: Path to the PANTHER FASTA/MSA directory.
panther_db.help_text: Leave null to download it from the matching *_latest_link. Downloaded databases are published under <outdir>/pre/databases; point this parameter at that directory to reuse them on a later run instead of refetching.

panther_latest_link.description: URL of the PANTHER archive fetched when panther_db is null.

panther_version.description: PANTHER release recorded for provenance in the process tag and execution report. Downloads follow panther_latest_link, not this value.

skip_pfam.help_text: Families belonging to this database are excluded from the benchmark universe. At least one of the four member databases must remain enabled. Nextflow passes `--skip_x true` from the CLI as a string, so a string-encoded boolean is accepted here; the workflow coerces it. The bare flag form `--skip_x` also works.

pfam_db.help_text: Leave null to download it from the matching *_latest_link. Downloaded databases are published under <outdir>/pre/databases; point this parameter at that directory to reuse them on a later run instead of refetching.

swissprot_db.description: Path to the SwissProt FASTA used for decoy selection.
swissprot_db.help_text: Leave null to download it from the matching *_latest_link. Downloaded databases are published under <outdir>/pre/databases; point this parameter at that directory to reuse them on a later run instead of refetching.

swissprot_latest_link.description: URL of the gzipped SwissProt FASTA fetched when swissprot_db is null.

swissprot_version.description: SwissProt release recorded for provenance in the process tag and execution report. Downloads follow swissprot_latest_link, not this value.

min_membership.description: Minimum InterPro family membership count retained for PRE sampling. Must be greater than zero.
min_membership.help_text: Nextflow 26 passes CLI values as strings, so a string-encoded number is accepted here; PIPELINE_INITIALISATION coerces it and rejects non-numeric or non-positive values.

num_per_db.description: Number of InterPro families to sample per database in PRE mode. Must be greater than zero.
num_per_db.help_text: Nextflow 26 passes CLI values as strings, so a string-encoded number is accepted here; PIPELINE_INITIALISATION coerces it and rejects non-numeric or non-positive values.

num_decoys.description: Number of SwissProt decoy sequences to sample in PRE mode. Must be greater than zero.
num_decoys.help_text: Nextflow 26 passes CLI values as strings, so a string-encoded number is accepted here; PIPELINE_INITIALISATION coerces it and rejects non-numeric or non-positive values.

seed.description: Optional random seed for reproducible PRE family and decoy sampling.

post_options.title: POST workflow options
post_options.description: Parameters used when workflow_mode is 'post'. PRE-output path parameters in this section are required for POST runs and ignored by PRE runs.

post_samplesheet.description: POST-only required CSV samplesheet with sample, tool, msa_dir, and optional clustering_tsv columns.

pre_id_registry.description: POST-only required path to the PRE id_registry.tsv.

pre_universe_fasta.description: POST-only required path to the PRE combined universe FASTA.

pre_universe_sha256.description: POST-only required path to the PRE universe SHA256 checksum file.

pre_sampled_metadata.description: POST-only required path to the PRE sampled metadata CSV.

pre_sampled_fasta_dir.description: POST-only required path to the PRE sampled FASTA directory.

match_threshold.description: Minimum F1 threshold used to call generated/original family matches in POST reports.
match_threshold.help_text: Nextflow 26 passes CLI values as strings, so a string-encoded number is accepted here; PIPELINE_INITIALISATION coerces it and rejects non-numeric or non-positive values.

association_threshold.description: Precision/recall threshold used for POST split and merge association calls.
association_threshold.help_text: Nextflow 26 passes CLI values as strings, so a string-encoded number is accepted here; PIPELINE_INITIALISATION coerces it and rejects non-numeric or non-positive values.

max_unmapped_fraction.description: Maximum allowed fraction of generated sequence IDs that cannot be mapped through the PRE id registry.
max_unmapped_fraction.help_text: Nextflow 26 passes CLI values as strings, so a string-encoded number is accepted here; PIPELINE_INITIALISATION coerces it and rejects non-numeric or non-positive values.

max_ambiguous_fraction.description: Maximum allowed fraction of ambiguous generated sequence ID mappings through the PRE id registry.
max_ambiguous_fraction.help_text: Nextflow 26 passes CLI values as strings, so a string-encoded number is accepted here; PIPELINE_INITIALISATION coerces it and rejects non-numeric or non-positive values.

min_intersection_size.description: Minimum generated/original universe-id intersection size used for POST split and merge associations. Must be greater than zero.
min_intersection_size.help_text: Nextflow 26 passes CLI values as strings, so a string-encoded number is accepted here; PIPELINE_INITIALISATION coerces it and rejects non-numeric or non-positive values.

min_universe_coverage.description: Optional minimum generated universe coverage required by POST Jaccard calculation.

scorecard_weights.description: Optional POST exploratory scorecard weights, provided as a JSON/object map or key=value string for mean_f1, family_coverage, sequence_coverage, no_decoy_recruitment, and no_split_merge.

skip_multiqc.description: Skip MultiQC report generation for POST runs when true.
skip_multiqc.help_text: Nextflow passes `--skip_x true` from the CLI as a string, so a string-encoded boolean is accepted here; the workflow coerces it. The bare flag form `--skip_x` also works.

boilerplate_options.title: Boilerplate options
boilerplate_options.description: Common runtime, publishing, and notification parameters.

outdir.description: Required output directory for published pipeline results.

publish_dir_mode.description: Nextflow publishDir mode used when publishing outputs.

email.description: Reserved no-op email notification parameter; defaults to null.

hook_url.description: Reserved no-op webhook notification parameter; defaults to null.
